rationale: Most direct source-level match for the self-healing concern. The entire package implements healing of broken element locators: autoheal/autoheal_locator.py (1551 lines) implements the flow quick-original-selector check -> selector cache -> AI DOM/visual healing -> re-cache (lines 1077-1287), with a defined ElementLocator ABC (autoheal/core/element_locator.py) and AIService ABC (autoheal/core/ai_service.py). Observed depth: 76 Python files / ~18,013 total LOC in the package (9,728 LOC in impl/), layered interface+impl structure across ai/providers (base + openai/gemini/anthropic/groq/deepseek/ollama), cache backends (file 695, redis 385, cachetools 328), resilience (resilience/circuit_breaker.py 172 + tenacity retry), metrics, reporting (reporting/autoheal_reporter.py 941), and both Selenium (582) and Playwright (562) adapters. Browser-automation concern is also touched via those two adapters. Docs include an implementation plan doc (autoheal/impl/ai/AI_PROVIDERS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md) plus 5 usage guides in docs/. Classified S for relevance+depth; heritage tag is a declared port of the Java autoheal-locator (README line 11, pyproject homepage), not independently verified.
limitations: Tests are thin relative to source: 3 test modules + conftest (~969 lines) vs ~18k LOC, and they are integration-style: tests/test_saucedemo_healing.py and tests/test_local_model_integration.py require a live saucedemo.com and a reachable local LLM endpoint (see module docstrings); no substantial unit suite for core healing logic was found.
Heritage is declared only (README.md line 11 states 'Python port of the original Java AutoHeal Locator'); the upstream Java repo was not present/verified in this tree.
Hybrid cache type is unimplemented stub (autoheal/autoheal_locator.py lines 1544-1547, 'Hybrid cache not yet implemented, using Cachetools').

Not a scraping pipeline itself: no JSON-LD/structured extraction, no pagination, no stealth, no job queue; it heals locators inside Selenium/Playwright automation and would need integration into a Veridian scraper.
Provider cost/speed/visual matrix in README (lines 447-457) is marketing text, not verified by measurement in this repo.
